screening_decisions.reason: Review article summarizing packing materials; not an RCT comparing steroid-eluting stents.
Retrospective review of operative findings; not an RCT and does not involve steroid-eluting stents.
Prospective controlled trial comparing revision ESS vs primary ESS; does not evaluate steroid-eluting stents.
RCT comparing levobupivacaine-soaked packs vs saline-soaked packs; levobupivacaine is not a steroid.
RCT comparing doxycycline-releasing stents vs placebo; doxycycline is an antibiotic, not a steroid.
RCT of steroid-eluting implant for in-office treatment of recurrent polyposis after prior ESS; patients are not undergoing FESS at time of intervention.
Cross-sectional prevalence survey; not an RCT.
Review article on pathogenesis; not an RCT.
RCT comparing dexamethasone (steroid)-eluting middle meatal spacer vs placebo spacer in adult CRS patients undergoing ESS. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing lidocaine-soaked packs vs saline-soaked packs; lidocaine is not a steroid.
RCT comparing hyaluronic acid dressing vs nonabsorbable packing; neither is steroid-eluting.
Position paper/guideline document; not an RCT.
RCT comparing gloved vs ungloved Merocel spacers; neither is steroid-eluting.
Epidemiological prevalence report; not an RCT.
RCT comparing mometasone furoate (steroid)-releasing implants vs non-drug-releasing implants in adult CRS patients undergoing ethmoidectomy/FESS. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing triamcinolone (steroid)-impregnated absorbable nasal dressing vs saline-impregnated dressing in adult CRS patients undergoing ESS. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing PA pack vs PA pack in glove finger; neither is steroid-eluting.
Prospective review of surgical failures; not an RCT.
Review article on etiology; not an RCT.
RCT comparing triamcinolone (steroid)-impregnated bioresorbable dressing vs saline-impregnated dressing in adult CRS patients with nasal polyps undergoing ESS. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing Nasopore vs Merocel in glove finger; neither is steroid-eluting.
Meta-analysis of 2 RCTs; not a primary RCT itself.
RCT comparing hylan gel vs control; hylan gel is not steroid-eluting.
RCT comparing triamcinolone (steroid)-impregnated absorbable gelatin dressing vs normal saline in adult CRS patients with polyposis undergoing FESS. Meets all criteria.
Retrospective analysis of adhesions; not an RCT.
RCT comparing drug-eluting (steroid) stents vs non-drug-eluting stents in adult CRS patients undergoing FESS. Directly meets all criteria.
RCT comparing hyaluronan resorbable packing (MeroGel) vs standard non-resorbable nasal dressing; neither is steroid-eluting.
Commentary/position piece; not an RCT.
Single-cohort trial without control group; not an RCT.
RCT comparing hyaluronic acid (Merogel) packs vs no packing; hyaluronic acid is not a steroid.
RCT comparing nonabsorbable packing vs saline irrigations; neither is steroid-eluting.
Prevalence survey; not an RCT.
RCT comparing triamcinolone (steroid)-impregnated bioabsorbable dressing vs saline-impregnated dressing in adult CRS patients undergoing bilateral ESS. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing postoperative prednisone vs placebo in patients who ALL received steroid-eluting spacers; does not compare steroid-eluting spacer vs non-steroid-eluting control.
RCT comparing tranexamic acid vs phenylephrine; neither is steroid-eluting.
Review article on stents; not an RCT.
RCT comparing hyaluronic acid hydrogel vs carboxymethylcellulose foam; neither is steroid-eluting.
